claims.claim_text: Li Hong, Wu Zetian's eldest son and crown prince, died suddenly at age 23 in 675; official records say natural death, while later accounts suggest Wu Zetian poisoned him

claims.claim_text: Li Xian (Emperor Zhongzong), third son, ascended in January 684 but was deposed after only 55 days in February 684 and exiled to Fangling

sources.title: 《旧唐书·中宗本纪》

claims.claim_zh: 无字碑无字主流观点：唐中宗李显神龙政变后追复唐朝，武周被后世视为「伪朝」，正史不立武周本纪，中宗故意不在碑上刻字以抹去母亲的武周皇帝身份
